flags.adu: This flag is based on a PROPOSED rule (Bill 2025-1545), which is not law yet and is currently held in council [reform.status]. If it passes, it could allow up to two accessory dwelling units (small secondary homes on the same lot) by right in this R2-H zoning district, without requiring the owner to live on site [zoning.district, reform.status].
flags.parking-minimum: This is also part of the PROPOSED bill, not current law [reform.status]. If passed, it would remove the requirement to build a minimum number of off-street parking spaces, which could free up land and money for more housing [reform.status].
flags.affordable-housing-bonus: This is another PROPOSED provision, not yet law [reform.status]. It would offer an optional bonus for including affordable housing, and this parcel is not inside the existing Inclusionary Housing Overlay area, which is a separate, already-in-effect affordable housing zone [overlay.iz, reform.status].
flags.hazard-undermined: The entire parcel is located in an area marked as undermined, meaning there may have once been underground mining beneath it [hazard.undermined]. This should be reviewed by a mine subsidence or geotechnical specialist before construction [hazard.undermined].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in a neighborhood with a low median land value, which often means projects here may need extra 'gap' financing to become feasible [hood.median_land_psf]. This is noted as information only, not a penalty against the parcel [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a lower-value area, it may qualify for special infill or blight-related scoring under PHFA (a state housing finance agency) programs [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
